title: Apache Druid
description: Broker and coordinator metrics — query performance, JVM health, GC activity, and HTTP thread pool saturation.

title: APM Metrics
description: Service APM built from span metrics. Overview: P50/P90/P99 latency, request rate, error percentage, and top operations. DB Metrics: calls per second, average duration, and error percentage by db.system. External calls: per-address rate, error percentage, and duration. Filter by deployment.environment, service.name, and top_level_operation.

title: DB Calls Monitoring
description: Built on top of available DB attributes from opentelemetry: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/attributes-registry/db/

title: HTTP API Monitoring
description: Built on top of available HTTP attributes from opentelemetry: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/attributes-registry/http/

title: ASP .NET Core Metrics
description: ASP.NET Core application metrics — request performance, process health, .NET runtime internals (GC, threading), and routing. Based on OTLP instrumentation.

title: AWS SQS Prometheus
description:
Dashboard is built on the provided metrics by Third-party prometheus exporters 
( https://github.com/jmal98/sqs-exporter )

title: cert-manager Monitoring
description: Monitors cert-manager health: certificate status, controller performance, ACME operations, webhook health, work queue, and resource usage. Scrape cert-manager port 9402 via OTel Collector Prometheus receiver.

title: CI/CD Observability
description: Dashboard displaying metrics from CI and CD systems.

title: Claude Code Metrics
description: Monitor Claude Code usage, costs, tokens, and productivity metrics

title: Clickhouse Overview
description: This dashboard provides a high-level overview of your Clickhouse Server hosts.

title: CloudNativePG
description: CloudNativePG cluster health from the native cnpg_* instance metrics: connections, throughput, cache, replication, WAL & archiving, checkpoints, storage, and the metrics collector itself.

title: Cohere
description: Demo dashboard for Cohere Chat, Embed, Rerank, model usage, latency, errors, token usage, and individual spans emitted by the cohere-otel service.

title: CouchDB
description: Basic metrics to monitor around CouchDB

title: Dify Service - Overview & LLM Observability
description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for the langgenius/dify service. Covers RED metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration), HTTP endpoint performance, LLM/GenAI activity (token usage, model latency, providers), workflow & app activity, and Postgres/Redis dependencies. Built from traces and metrics observed for the service.

title: DSPy Observability
description: Reusable DSPy observability dashboard for programs instrumented with openinference-instrumentation-dspy: module/chain/tool activity, latency, model calls, and errors. Built on DSPy-native span attributes (openinference.span.kind, llm.model_name). Use the service_name picker to filter to one or more DSPy services.

title: Container Metrics - ECS
description: Container Metrics Dashboard of ECS using sidecar

title: Instance Metrics - ECS
description: Instance Metrics Dashboard of ECS EC2

title: Elasticsearch Monitoring Dashboard
description: Elasticsearch monitoring dashboard built on the OpenTelemetry Collector elasticsearch receiver, covering cluster health & shard state, node-level CPU/disk/HTTP metrics, etc.

title: Firecrawl Monitoring
description: Monitors Firecrawl SDK usage instrumented by firecrawl-otel: call volume, latency, error rate, credits consumed, and results returned, broken down per operation (scrape/search/map/crawl/batch_scrape). Built on trace spans (firecrawl.operation EXISTS), so it renders for both short-lived jobs and long-running services.

title: FluxCD — Controllers
description: FluxCD controller health: reconciliation throughput, errors, duration, workqueues, runtime resources, and Kubernetes API traffic.

title: Go Runtime Metrics
description: Go runtime metrics dashboard for monitoring memory, goroutines, and scheduler performance

title: Hermes Coding Agent — Observability
description: Comprehensive monitoring for the Hermes coding agent: agent sessions/turns, LLM API calls & token usage, tool-call activity, latency, and errors. Built from OTel traces (service: hermes-agent) using gen_ai.* and hermes.* span attributes. Panels are grouped top-to-bottom: Overview (scorecards), LLM/Model, Agent/Turns, Tool Calls, Errors.

title: Host Metrics
description: This dashboard uses the system metrics collected from the `hostmetrics` receiver to show CPU, Memory, Disk, Network and Filesystem usage

title: Host Metrics (k8s)
description: This dashboard uses the system metrics collected from the `hostmetrics` receiver to show CPU, Memory, Disk, Network and Filesystem usage

title: Istio Monitoring Dashboard
description: Istio service mesh dashboard for Istio, Envoy, Pilot, Citadel, Galley, and Kubernetes resource metrics collected in SigNoz.

title: Jenkins
description:
Monitor: Scale from 0 or to 0
Specific Instance type based on request
Resource Usage of jobs

title: JVM Metrics
description: JVM Runtime metrics for service

title: Host Metrics (k8s)
description: This dashboard uses the system metrics collected from the `hostmetrics` receiver to show CPU, Memory, Disk, Network and Filesystem usage

title: Kubernetes Cluster Events
description: This dashboard displays specific event and object kind counts, as well as their respective time-series charts, allowing the viewer to understand what's happening inside a cluster at a glance.

title: Kubernetes Cluster Metrics
description: This dashboard uses the metrics sent using `k8sclusterreceiver` to show the desired and currently running pods for deployments, daemonsets, statefulset, replicasets and pods count by phase.

title: Kubernetes CronJobs: Current State and Recent Runs
description: Current state shows the Jobs Kubernetes still keeps. Recent runs shows the Job runs SigNoz observed in the selected time range.

title: Kubernetes Node Metrics - Detailed
description: This dashboard uses the Kubernetes node metrics collected from the kubeletstats receiver to show CPU, Memory, Filesystem, and Network usage per node.

title: Kubernetes Pod Metrics - Detailed
description: This dashboard uses the Kubernetes pod metrics collected from the kubeletstats receiver to show CPU, Memory (usage, RSS, working set), Filesystem, and Network I/O & errors per pod across namespaces.

title: Kubernetes API Server
description: Standard control-plane view for kube-apiserver using Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metrics.

title: Kubernetes Controller Manager
description: Standard control-plane view for kube-controller-manager workqueues, retries, and client request pressure.

title: Kubernetes CoreDNS
description: Cluster DNS view for request volume, cache efficiency signals, and request duration buckets.

title: Kubernetes Etcd
description: Standard etcd view using native etcd server metrics (leadership, proposals, client request traffic, and storage latency).

title: Kubernetes Kube Proxy
description: Network-agent view for kube-proxy sync loops, network programming durations, and client request rates.

title: Kubernetes Kubelet
description: Node-agent view for kubelet runtime operations, pod lifecycle, and storage operation latencies.

title: Kubernetes Scheduler
description: Standard control-plane view for kube-scheduler queue pressure, scheduling throughput, and duration buckets.

title: Kubernetes System Overview
description: Combined view across control-plane, node, networking, and DNS components with distro-neutral service scoping.

title: Kafka Server Monitoring
description: Monitors Kafka brokers, topics, partitions, and consumer groups using OTel kafkametricsreceiver metrics.

title: KEDA Dashboard
description: KEDA OpenTelemetry dashboard for operator build info, scaler activity, scaler latency, scaling errors, registered resources, triggers, scale-loop latency, and CloudEventSource signals.

title: Key operations
description: RED metrics for a service's key operations, grouped by operation (top 20). P50, P90, and P99 latency, request rate, and error percentage. Filter by deployment.environment and service.name.

title: Kong Gateway
description: Kong API Gateway monitoring using the OpenTelemetry plugin (Kong 3.13+). Covers request rate, latency percentiles, error metrics, bandwidth, upstream health, and Lua memory. Variables: environment, Kong service.

title: Langflow — Workflow & LLM Usage Monitoring
description: Monitors Langflow flows/agents with an emphasis on LLM usage: token consumption (input/output/total), per-model breakdown, LLM call latency, tool calls, agent/flow runs, errors, and recent LLM calls. Built on the gen_ai.* OpenTelemetry span attributes exported by Langflow's built-in Traceloop tracer.

title: Memcached
description: Dashboard to monitor Memcached

title: Meter Breakdown
description: Provides breakdown of meter by service and environment. Please use time range greater than 1 hour as meter data is aggregated over 1 hour intervals.

title: Mongo overview
description: This dashboard provides a high-level overview of your MongoDB. It includes read/write performance, most-used replicas, collection metrics etc...

title: Ingress Nginx - Request Handling Performance
description: Ingress-nginx controller request-handling performance (nginx_ingress_controller_* metrics scraped via Prometheus → OTel). Filter by ingress.

title: NGINX (OTEL)
description: NGINX metrics from the OpenTelemetry nginx receiver: request throughput, accepted and handled connections, and current connections by state (active, reading, writing, waiting). Scope with the host.name and service.name variables.

title: NGINX Ingress controller
description: Ingress-nginx controller health and performance — request volume, success rate, config reloads, CPU/memory, network I/O, and latency percentiles. Filter by namespace, controller class, controller pod, and ingress.

title: OpenClaw — Full Comprehensive Dashboard
description: Comprehensive OpenClaw dashboard combining the Overview panels (token usage, message flow, queue & session health, error logs) with all panels from OpenClaw — Error Monitoring (agent run errors, error rate, errors by model/channel/provider, slowest operations, errored span detail).

title: OpenCode
description: Monitor OpenCode usage, costs, tokens, and productivity metrics

title: OpenTelemetry Collector
description: Pipeline health for the OTel Collector: receiver throughput, processor drops, exporter delivery, queue depth, and process resources.

title: PgBouncer
description: PgBouncer connection pooler health: client/server pool states, query and transaction throughput, wait times, network, prepared statements, and per-database connections. Built on the prometheus-community pgbouncer_exporter metrics.

title: PlanetScale PostgreSQL
description: Track PlanetScale Postgres connections, session states, PgBouncer pools, commits, locks, WAL archiving, storage, and pod resources. Use branch and role filters.

title: PlanetScale Vitess (MySQL)
description: Track PlanetScale Vitess query rate, latency, pools, MySQL internals, replication lag, VTOrc, storage, and pod resources. Use branch, keyspace, and tablet type filters.

title: Postgres overview
description: This dashboard provides a high-level overview of your PostgreSQL databases. It includes replication, locks, and throughput etc...

title: RabbitMQ Metricsl (OTEL)
description: Dashboard for rabbitmq metrics provided by (rabbitmqreceiver)[https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/blob/main/receiver/rabbitmqreceiver]

title: Redis overview
description: This dashboard shows the Redis instance overview. It includes latency, hit/miss rate, connections, and memory information.

title: Ingestion
description:
This dashboard shows the metrics, traces and logs ingested.  Please follow the following guides to control your data sent to SigNoz. Only last 15 minutes of data is shown as this is mainly intended to help you understand the recent volume. 

Metrics: https://signoz.io/docs/userguide/drop-metrics/


Logs: https://signoz.io/docs/logs-management/guides/drop-logs/


Traces: https://signoz.io/docs/traces-management/guides/drop-spans/

description: This dashboard plots all the important metrics for Snowflake.
